articleTitle: Intrusion Detection in Smart Homes: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: We have seen remarkable growth in smart home technologies that provide conveniences we have never experienced before, but also create entirely new security challenges. The importance of the role of intrusion detection systems (IDS) in an environment cannot be overestimated, it is crucial to detect violations and prevent breaches. In this paper, we critically review the existing IDS approaches pertaining to smart homes, which includes signature-based, anomaly-based, and hybrid approaches. Focuses on the synergy between machine learning, IoT integration and computing environments, such as edge and cloud computing. The described study analyzes technological solutions for IDS, fills the research gap, and provides the corresponding future development directions, thus confirming the necessity of strong, dynamic, and privacy-aware IDS tailored for the requirements of smart home environments.

articleTitle: Data Reliability and Survival Analysis for Breast Cancer Patients Using Real Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Among the illnesses that have recently been identified as endangering the lives of females globally is breast carcinoma. Early detection of breast cancer is crucial since it increases the range of available treatments and raises patients' chances of surviving. This study aimed to examine data reliability. This study, conducted on 760 female patients, was a comprehensive investigation into the reliability of breast cancer data. The data was self-gathered from a healthcare hospital from October 2019 to October 2022, ensuring a complete and accurate representation. Mammography reports and personal information were collected. Initially, a KMO (Kaiser-Meyer-Olkin) test was carried out to ensure the data size was appropriate for exploratory factor analysis. The score must be greater than 0.80 for acceptance. The assessment of the KMO test concerning the collected dataset is 0.86, which is higher than the threshold, demonstrating the thoroughness of data collection. Then, Bartlett's test of sphericity (P is 0) proved that the sample size for exploratory factor analysis was adequate and that the normal distribution was present. Furthermore, the reliability was evaluated employing Cronbach's alpha coefficient. The Kaplan-Meier test has been utilized to assess the consequences of various health parameters on cancer patients' survival over time.

articleTitle: Data Visualization and Predictive Analytics in Manufacturing: A New Paradigm in Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Technology has come a long way with data science as its evolution has led to major changes in all types of industry. This paper deals with the optimization of data visualization of predictive maintenance in the field of manufacturing. Predictive maintenance is a technique which is applied by manufacturing companies to foresee any equipment failures. This is performed by examining data from sensors or various other sources. By recognizing potential failures, the companies can avoid equipment downtime, costly failures and maintain their maintenance schedules. The traditional preservation practices include fixing an equipment once the breakdown occurs or during fixed maintenance schedules. However, this can be time consuming and can affect the company's schedule or it can be costly. This issue can be targeted through predictive maintenance. This includes collecting data from factors such as air temperature, process temperature, rotational speed, torque and tool wear. Through this visualization, a clear correlation can be made between the various factors provided using power BI.

articleTitle: Optimizing Traffic Signal Control Using Reinforcement Learning for Enhanced Traffic Flow Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: In this paper, the techniques used to optimize traffic light timing in urban environments are discussed. It remains a significant challenge, especially with the increasing complexity of current traffic systems. Tabular Q-learning was the mainstay of early methods from the 1990s, but it was constrained by narrow state spaces and simple traffic measures, which frequently led to less-than-ideal management techniques. [Recent advancements in deep reinforcement learning (DRL) offer new possibilities by combining deep learning with RL to estimate Q-values more effectively. However, most existing studies still focus on simple intersection models, lack comprehensive cycle timing, and do not utilize the latest advancements in DRL, such as dueling deep Q networks. By creating a model that can handle intricate intersection scenarios with several phases and high-dimensional action spaces, this research seeks to overcome current shortcomings. Smooth transitions between traffic signal phases are integrated with advanced value based deep reinforcement learning techniques in the proposed approach. Comprehensive simulations are used to assess how well the model performs in terms of timing optimization for traffic control systems, showing enhanced performance under certain conditions. This research leverages advanced Dueling DQN techniques to address the complexities of multi-phase intersection management, distinguishing it from existing models that primarily focus on single-phase intersections [16].

articleTitle: WATTY - A Water Surveillance and Cleaning Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative water surveillance and cleaning system aimed at surveying the water quality in urban water bodies. A real time monitoring and autonomous cleaning mechanism system is developed for water pollution. The surveillance component is a network of sensors to continuously monitor different water quality parameters. The cleaning mechanism features an autonomous mechanism machine with conveyer belt equipped to the surface vehicle in order to remove floating waste. Experimental results from field deployments in several urban lakes demonstrate the system's capability to maintain and monitor water quality within safe thresholds. Water surveillance and cleaning system help into reducing the day to day pollution level, offering an effective solution for urban water management. This system represents a milestone in automated environmental control for the health of aquatic animals, offering a clear and sustainable option for system maintenance.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Framework for Stock Prediction: Leveraging NLP Models, Technical Analysis, and Fundamental Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: This study delineates a thorough methodology for forecasting stock trends by amalgamating news sentiment analysis through various Natural Language Processing (NLP) models with both technical and fundamental analysis. Conventional stock prediction techniques frequently depend on discrete methodologies, concentrating either on historical pricing data or market fundamentals. However, given the burgeoning accessibility of real-time news alongside advancements in NLP, the integration of qualitative data into predictive models has become not only viable but increasingly crucial. In this scholarly inquiry, we establish a hybrid framework that fuses multiple NLP models to scrutinise and quantify the sentiment and pertinence of financial news. The insights garnered are subsequently integrated with technical indicators and fundamental metrics to augment the precision of stock trend forecasts. The NLP models employed in this investigation encompass sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, and topic modelling, which collectively furnish a robust comprehension of news that influences market movements. Technical analysis is executed utilizing algorithms that assess price trajectories, trading volume, and additional market indicators, whereas fundamental analysis capitalizes on financial ratios and macroeconomic data. The proposed model undergoes evaluation on a varied dataset that includes historical stock prices, financial disclosures, and news articles. We apply an array of machine learning and deep learning algorithms to scrutinise the data and anticipate prospective stock movements. The findings indicate that our integrated framework surpasses traditional models, yielding considerable enhancements in predictive accuracy. This research accentuates the significance of a multifaceted strategy to stock prediction, amalgamating the strengths of NLP, technical, and fundamental analysis to furnish a more comprehensive insight into market dynamics.

articleTitle: ShopSavvy - Empowering Local Commerce Through Online Price Comparison with AI Integration for Customers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative e-commerce platform designed to empower local vendors by providing a space to sell products and groceries online. The platform incorporates two key features aimed at enhancing customer experience and promoting local businesses. The first feature leverages a price comparison tool, allowing users to compare the prices of local products across various vendors, thus promoting competitive pricing. The second feature utilizes AI (via ChatGPT API) to generate food recipes based on user input and recommend the ingredients required for each dish. Users can purchase these ingredients directly from the platform, fostering a seamless shopping experience. The system is developed using PHP, MySQL, and XAMPP, with AI integration via the ChatGPT API. The platform aims to bridge the gap between urban and rural markets by offering localized solutions for online shopping, benefiting both vendors and consumers. This paper discusses the platform's design, functionality, and potential impact on hyper-local e-commerce and grocery retail.

articleTitle: BankBot: Streamlined Banking Support Through Centralized FAQs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: BankBot is a centralized platform that is created to improve customer support's efficiency and accessibility in the banking sector. It contains frequently asked questions from majorbanks on a single platform. By including FAQs, BankBot engages in the process of streamlining and locating required and necessary information and also decreases the effort required by users to navigate and find solutions to problems across several websites. The chatbot offers appropriate solutions that are smooth along with real-time support to all customers. This enhances overall customer satisfaction, decreases pressure present on the customer relations team, and enables clients to receive prompt service. For a stable and flawless user experience, the platform is developed using technologies like cloud-based infrastructure and natural language processing (NLP). BankBot makes it simple to find precise and effective information quickly. BankBot improves information delivery consistency and accessibility while focusing on user confidence and the process of compiling data from manyinstitutions. Also, the platform creates a transformation in the normal customer service technique by empowering users and providing them with the required information at their fingertips. The platform provides a simplified, effective, and user-focused answer to banking questions, raising the standard for customer care in the banking industry and paving the path for more effective service delivery to customers.

articleTitle: Multi-Version Analysis of YOLO: A Deep Dive into YOLOv5, YOLOv7, and YOLOv9 for Face and Person Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: This paper compares three modern YOLO models-YOLOv5, YOLOv7, and YOLOv9-concentrating on how well they work at real-time object identification, which is a vital need for applications like driverless cars and smart surveillance. With its optimisation for edge devices, YOLOv5 provides effective performance even in contexts with limited resources. Although YOLOv9 adds multi-scale feature fusion and dynamic convolution to boost accuracy in complicated circumstances, YOLOv7 improves detection accuracy through enhanced feature pyramids. The trade-offs between detection accuracy, processing speed, and computing demands are highlighted by the experimental findings, which help choose the best YOLO model for a given set of use cases.

articleTitle: The Future of Work: Impacts of AI on Employment and Job Market Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is constantly advancing and redefining routine jobs and other areas of life that were previously immune. The article examines how AI may play a role in changing employment terms and conditions and presents both concerns and benefits. Through a comprehensive literature review and analysis of current research, we investigate whether AI-powered automated processes will lead to the elimination of existing jobs, the creation of new job roles, and the necessary skills to be a successful employee in the future. Other than the proposed strategies for implementation and adaptation, we also aim to provide an efficient transition to an AI-powered workforce by enforcing policies that favour a transformed workforce. The conclusion indicates how these measures might be approached. For example, these measures could be reoriented (proactive reskilling and upskilling initiatives) towards collaboration (realising the potential of the multitude of parties) among policymakers, educators, and industry leaders for this purpose.

articleTitle: Big Data Evolution: A Deep Dive Into Gradient Descentand Smart Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Study examines the obstacles presented by big data processing and evaluates optimization strategies, with a particular emphasis on Tailored Principal Component Analysis for efficient data management. The vast and complex nature of big data often overwhelms conventional methods. A crucial challenge in feature engineering is identifying the most impactful features for machine learning models by eliminating redundant or irrelevant variables. Tailored PCA, a dimensionality reduction technique, enhances computational efficiency and model generalization by retaining components that explain 90% of the data variance. It transforms correlated features into uncorrelated principal components, reducing multicollinearity and improving accuracy. To further refine this approach, we propose incorporating Sample Gradient Descent with Tailored PCA. Our experiments demonstrate that applying Tailored PCA before gradient descent methods like Stochastic Gradient Descent and Mini-Batch Gradient Descent significantly enhances model performance.

articleTitle: User-Centric Online Rental Platform: Enhancing the Traveler Experience
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: A new novelty in rental property, “Visitly: Your Gateway to Memorable Stays” is designed to revolutionize the online experience for both landlords and tenants. By defeating existing solutions' limitations like insufficient data, restricted visual aids, and incompatible search experiences, Visitly aims to provide a more efficient and superior platform than its rivals. The project meets the needs of tenants who are searching for their dream spot to reside and property owners who are attempting to showcase their places on the greatest platform. By living up to the reality and expectations with powerful features like immersive 360-degree views, Google Maps integration, and strong authentication systems Visitly ensures transparency and confidence in the rental process.

articleTitle: A Transparent and Secure Vote Casting System Using Blockchain: A Critical Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Imagine a voting system where every vote is secure, every result is transparent, and voter privacy is protected. Blockchain technology can make this vision a reality by solving the ongoing problems of traditional voting system, like fraud, manipulation, and lack of trust. This review looks at how blockchain's decentralized, unchangeable, and easily verified features can completely change the way voting systems work. Through real-world researches, case studies and cutting-edge applications like Ethereum smart contracts and permissioned blockchains, this paper illustrates how blockchain can not only fortify the voting process but also make it faster and more accessible. By addressing the crucial challenges of scalability and legal compliance, we highlight the most promising innovations that are pushing the boundaries of secure, tamper-proof elections.

articleTitle: Optimizing Soft Failure Detection in Elastic Optical Networks: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms Note: Sub-Titles are not Captured in Xplore and Should not be Used
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: This document is a model and instructions for LATEX. Maintaining efficiency and performance in Elastic Optical Networks (EONs) requires a robust system for detecting “soft failures” -issues that gradually impact network performance without an immediate outage. A reliable detection system helps enable proactive maintenance, better use of resources, and fewer downtime and repair costs, all of which contribute to smooth and high-quality data transmission. This study explores machine learning techniques to detect soft failures in Elastic Optical Networks (EONs), a key element in supporting network reliability. We evaluated several classification algorithms, including random forest, gradient boost, support vector machine, and decision tree algorithms using simulated network data. To measure the effectiveness of each algorithm, we analyzed accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. Our results indicate that the Random Forest, Decision Tree, and Gradient Boosting algorithms all reached a perfect accuracy of 100%. However, Random Forest outperformed the others in precision, recall, and F1 score, showing it as the most effective overall. Although all three algorithms are suitable in terms of accuracy, Random Forest stands out due to its consistently superior results across all evaluated metrics. This comprehensive comparison highlights the value of machine learning in enhancing soft failure detection within EONs, with Random Forest emerging as a highly reliable choice.

articleTitle: Polarimetric Decomposition Analysis of Lunar North Pole Crater Hermite-A Using Chandrayaan-2 DFSAR Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Chandrayaan-2 launched in the year of July 22, 2019 consisting of different types of sensors to map the lunar surface. It integrates Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) at two wavelengths (L and S band) at various resolutions with numerous polarimetric ways in a lightweight configuration (about 20 kg). The computation of the 2×2 complex scattering matrix for each resolution cell can be obtained from the DFSAR (Dual Frequency Synthetic Aperture Radar) which enables the characterization of the lunar surface at different incident angles, wavelengths in terms of polarization properties of the radar. This paper mainly focuses on various decomposition techniques and analysis of backscattering coefficients of the lunar surface using full polarimetric L-band DFSAR data. The data is collected from PSR (Permanent Shadowed Region) of lunar north polar Hermit-a Crater.

articleTitle: Smart Transport Hub
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The Smart Transport Hub is a web-based application designed to streamline the process of finding and comparing travel options across flights, trains, and buses. By integrating multiple transportation APIs, the platform fetches real-time data on available routes, prices, and schedules. Users can input departure and destination locations, budget, and the level of urgency to get personalized suggestions for traveling. It will consider the costeffective while ensuring quality and conveniences into an optimum travel solution for any user. Developed using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, and Firebase, the Smart Transport Hub aims to enhance the travel planning experience through an intuitive and efficient interface.

articleTitle: Capnivesh: Financing Platform for Startups
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: This article presents a ground-breaking crowdfunding tool just for startups. It locates possible investors for startups using machine learning algorithms. The platform addresses the fragmented nature of the startup funding market by providing a tailored recommendation technique that considers a business's industry, stage of development, and specific financial needs. The architecture, user interface, security protocols, and platform design, development, and implementation are all thoroughly covered in this article. The effectiveness of the platform is confirmed by a pilot study, which also shows significant advantages in the startup fundraising procedure.

articleTitle: E-Voting 2.0: A Blockchain Blueprint for Secure Elections
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: At a time when confidence in electoral processes is declining, our study proposes a new concept for voting, which is consequent on using blockchain technology. This innovative system guarantees absolute protection and credibility in the voting process, with rigging problems and underhand work prevalent in the manual/online voting methods. By developing and implementing reliable voter verification and immediate vote counting, we enhance democracy, giving individuals the complete confidence to vote. Using a blockchain banking system maintains voter anonymity through a blockchain ledger and ensures openness and accountability for every vote cast. Thus, as we rise beyond the surface of this approach, we discover the right direction for building a future in which elections are safer, more efficient, and credible. It enriches the current literature and opens new paths to future electoral integrity studies.

articleTitle: Real-time Criminal Face Recognition Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: This paper considers the relative performance of three popular machine learning models: Convolutional Neural Networks, Recurrent Neural Networks, and YOLOv8 (You Only Look Once version 8), in the process of real-time criminal face recognition. Such correct identification of someone in real-time live video feeds can be of much help to law enforcement in this high-tech security world. Comparing the strengths and weaknesses of every one of these models, CNNs are great for image feature extraction, RNNs good for the need to process sequences for temporal analysis, and YOLOv8 is good for the speed of object detection. The evaluation uses the performance metric-based accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Distance measures, such as Manhattan and Euclidean distances, will be implemented for comparison in face recognition. The outcome of this research shows that YOLOv8 has been shown to process the fastest, while CNNs have proven better at recognition tasks and RNNs improved model recognition of temporal context. This work on criminal face recognition requires optimization in selecting apt models for enhancing the power of real-time surveillance in matters of safety issues in the public sphere.

articleTitle: GeoDrishti: Automatic Road Extraction and Alert Generation for New Roads from Satellite Imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Efficient monitoring of road networks is crucial for urban planning and infrastructure development. This paper presents GeoDrishti, an innovative system for automatic road extraction and alert generation from satellite imagery. Leveraging medium-resolution images from the Resourcesat LISS IV sensor available through the Bhoonidhi portal, our system addresses the challenge of detecting roads with widths of 20m and above. We employ a U-Net architecture optimized for road segmentation, coupled with a novel change detection algorithm to identify newly constructed or modified roads. The system integrates these components with an automated alert mechanism, notifying users of significant changes via email. Our implementation includes a user-friendly GUI for specifying areas of interest and managing alerts, with outputs in the form of geographically referenced shapefiles. Experimental results demonstrate an F1 score of 0.8 in road detection across diverse geographical areas, with a 90% precision in identifying newly constructed roads. The system processes a 240x240 pixel image in under 35 seconds on standard hardware, representing a 75% reduction in time compared to manual interpretation. GeoDrishti offers a scalable, efficient solution for road network monitoring, with potential applications in urban planning, map updating, and rapid response scenarios. This research contributes to the field of remote sensing by combining deep learning-based road extraction with efficient change detection, addressing the dual challenges of accurate road detection and timely change identification.

articleTitle: Workload Prediction and its Impact on QoS of Microservices Architecture Based Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Microservices is an architectural style used for developing modular and scalable applications. The distributed and de centralised architectural property of microservices applications makes it difficult to manage unpredictable workload variations and sometimes lead to degraded QoS of the applications. Accurate workload prediction is important for efficient resource allocation and maintaining high QoS of the MSA based applications. This paper proposes an LSTM-RNN based model to predict the workload of each microservice instance and after that an analysis is done to identify the effects of proactive workload management on the QoS metrics such as response time, throughput, and CPU utilisation. The results show that the workload prediction accuracy significantly improves the latency, resource utilisation and performance of microservices applications.

articleTitle: Evaluating Data-Driven Models to Enhance Employee Retention and Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Employee attrition presents considerable challenges for organizations, affecting productivity, employee morale, and financial health. This research seeks to create and evaluate data-driven models to more accurately forecast employee turnover. By analyzing various employee data, such as demographic details, job-related factors, and performance metrics, machine learning techniques are used to uncover the primary drivers of attrition. The goal is to identify the most effective model for prediction, of-fering practical insights to shape employee retention strategies. In conclusion, this study contributes to the development of proactive measures aimed at reducing attrition and enhancing workforce management. This study employs Logistic Regression and Ran-dom Forest, each bringing distinct advantages to HR analytics over conventional approaches. Logistic Regression is appreciated for its ease of interpretation, making it highly applicable for HR insights. Conversely, the ensemble nature of Random Forest enhances prediction accuracy by effectively identifying non-linear trends commonly found in employee behavior. By combining these models, the approach provides both robust predictive capabilities and valuable insights into major attrition factors, which are essential for crafting targeted retention strategies.

articleTitle: MobileViT: A Hybrid Deep Learning Model for Efficient Brain Tumor Detection and Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Early and accurate diagnosis of brain tumors is crucial to the right management. Standard Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) has proved useful in medical image analysis; however, due to their inherent high computational requirements, they cannot run efficiently on resource constraint systems including the mobile. In this article, we explore the deployment of MobileViT as a condense model that integrates convolutional layers and ViT for forecasting as well as delineation of brain tumors from MRI scans. MobileViT is developed with efficiency as well as performance in mind and they are best fit for use in mobile end devices especially in telemedicine services. MobileViT is evaluated in association with the BraTS 2021 dataset for the classification and segmentation of brain tumors in terms of accuracy, computational complexity, and the ability to learn specific characteristics as well as overall features within an image. The study shows that MobileViT is best suited for achieving the right balance of the model's complexity, performance, and model inference time; it achieves a Die Coefficient of 0.87 in segmentation tasks and 40% less inference time than CNN models. Further, recommendations are proposed to enhance the practicalities of application of telemedicine systems so that accurate diagnosis for patients in other low resource settings can be made in real-time, a measure with big implications for quicker identification or patients problems, and improved patient prognosis.

articleTitle: Music Recommendation Using Facial Emotions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Music lets us feel all the possible emotions that we experience in our lives. Music can help raise someone's mood and also help people calm and relax themselves. The thought behind the topic was that the system utilizes the emotional expression of the user and recommends music that aligns with the emotions. This research paper explores the uses facial expression analysis and machine learning to provide personalized music recommendations. It uses emotional AI to understand and interpret users' facial expressions, allowing the system to gauge their mood and suggest songs that align with their feelings. The system uses OpenCV for facial recognition and TensorFlow for emotion detection. Once the user's emotional state is identified, it uses the Spotify API to curate a list of songs that match the detected emotions. This seamless integration ensures users receive timely and appropriate music recommendations. Initial tests have shown high accuracy in detecting emotions, with positive feedback on the relevance of the recommended songs. This innovative use of technology not only showcases the potential for personalized entertainment but also sets a new standard for user interaction in digital music platforms. As the technology continues to evolve, further improvements and refinements are expected to make personalized music recommendations even more accurate and enjoyable. The findings of this research aim to contribute to the develop features to assist music therapists in treating patients with mental stress, anxiety, acute depression, and trauma. Increased user engagement with the system, as personalized recommendations align more closely with individual tastes which will foster a sense of connection with the music content. The project will also result in a recommendation system that adopts to changes in user preferences over time. The system will help user in boosting their mood and have more optimistic state of mind.

articleTitle: Integrating Deep Learning and Python for Effective Sign Language Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The advancement in technology has improved the accessibility of communications for a person with hearing impairment significantly. A full implementation approach for sign language recognition is provided based on deep learning techniques implemented in Python. Several neural network architectures have been explored to achieve a level of high accuracy in the recognition of ASL gestures from video data based on CNNs and LSTM networks. The dataset for this is pretty diverse sign language gestures, like there is a sign language gesture describing ‘cow’ and then another describing ‘panda’. The two models are then trained and tested based on the whole dataset. Apart from training and testing, we also discuss preprocessing techniques, data augmentation, optimization strategies to improve the performance of the model. We prove that the proposed system, in fact, is a real-time sign language recognition system, providing an intuitive interface for the users. Results indicate, therefore, a good integration extent of the deep learning frameworks with Python and bring considerable improvements concerning accuracy and efficiency of sign language interpretation-all leading to better communication and inclusion in cases among the deaf and hardof-hearing community.

articleTitle: Optimize the Time a Mercedes-Benz Spends on the Test Bench Using Stacking Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The automotive industry relies heavily on test bench evaluations to ensure product quality and compliance with safety standards. A test bench is a platform or setup where various components or systems of a vehicle are tested under controlled conditions. A Mercedes-Benz vehicle spends lot of time on the test bench and a lot of features impact the testing time. By utilizing anonymized data gathered from various tests and simulations, this study seeks to identify key features that significantly impact the testing duration. Therefore, this paper aims to optimize the duration a Mercedes- Benz vehicle spends on the test bench by leveraging anonymized features. To achieve this, machine learning algorithms will be employed to analyze and interpret these features, ultimately enabling the development of predictive models. In specific, a stacking ensemble model with Random Forest Regressor, Extra-Tree Regressor and Lasso Regressor is proposed to streamline testing processes, enhance efficiency and productivity in Mercedes- Benz manufacturing plants. The proposed stacking model is compared with individual machine learning models and it is observed that stacking model outperforms individual models attaining highest <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R^{2}$</tex> score of 0.4367, indicating its effectiveness in combining the strengths of multiple algorithms.
