articleTitle: Enhanced Railway Safety System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The Enhanced Railway Safety System seeks to protect railroads by detecting probable risks and triggering automated alarm if the system is in any kind of danger. The system monitors by tracking the barriers and threats to the railway due to any obstacles on track using sensors, micro controllers and wireless communication. Instant alerts for both the train operators and train passengers are generated and emergency brakes are applied when a decision algorithm recognizes obstacles or threats. The prototype was field tested with the system achieving detection rates over ninety percent with a detection time of less than 2 seconds. It was proficient in tracking obstructions and relayed this information in real-time to the controlling unit. This automatic system reduces the manual input needed and reduces the chances of human error or equipment failures causing accidents. The project provides safety with little displacement of existing structures and can be executed in many railway networks. In future, the developments may be in the areas of improving algorithms for detection and utilizing deep learning more in predicting safety.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing Enhancing Human-Computer Interaction for Disabled
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Such as physical interaction, individuals with disabilities often encounter barriers when accessing and interacting with traditional computer interfaces. Navigating the digital interface poses challenges for those with disabilities. The necessity for innovative solutions is underscored by the main issue of limited accessibility to computer interfaces for individuals with disabilities. At present time, Human-Computer Interaction technology is most known in the tech industry. Which enables any individual to interact with system or computer. Here, Natural Language Processing plays a major component in the advancement of Human-Computer Interaction technology. This paper surveys recent methods, techniques like embedding, Word2Vec and technology to help in improvement of the Human-Computer Interaction. This work highlights the need of integration of advance Natural Language Processing like with Human-Computer Interaction for people with disabilities. This paper also proposes work on a hands-free device navigation system or application for differently abled peoples.

articleTitle: Smart Door Security System with Facial Recognition: Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: This research paper introduces an innovative approach to enhance home security through a smart door unlock system utilizing facial recognition technology. The system stores authorized faces in a database and empowers administrators to make real-time decisions on granting access to unauthorized individuals. Leveraging the capabilities of ESP32Cam controller and a sensor network, our proposed model ensures secure, scalable, and efficient access control. The framework offers decentralization of information within the home environment, en-suring protection for both residents and customers alike. Through exhaustive theoretical analysis and extensive experimentation across various scenarios, the paper demonstrates the effectiveness and significance of our smart door unlock system in modern home automation.

articleTitle: AI Career Guidance Tool
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: In today's rapidly evolving job market, choosing the right career path can be overwhelming. The AI Career Guidance Tool aims to simplify this process by offering personalized career advice and enhancing decision-making through advanced machine learning algorithms. Built with Python, database technologies, and libraries like PyTorch, this tool provides tailored recommendations based on individual skills, interests, and aspirations. It also features a dynamic system that adapts to changing trends, ensuring that its guidance remains relevant and timely. By integrating these cutting-edge technologies, the AI Career Guidance Tool empowers users to make informed decisions and confidently navigate their professional journeys in a constantly changing landscape.

articleTitle: An Improvised Way Towards Development of Multipurpose Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The Android Development domain has expanded a lot over the period of time. Over the course, it provided usage and deployment of multi-purpose ap plications that provided multiple functions in a single application. The system, due to a lack of proper implementation, degraded over a period of time proving it to be inefficient. The systems were expensive to develop and were difficult to maintain. The main drawback was that modules were too independent under the same application. The proposed system provides a better framework about the same concept that highlights the drawbacks earlier systems had and the inefficiency of the available solution. It complies with the basics of architectural development of any application. The primary change is in re-modelling the structure of the development that creates an opportunity to test and deploy mobile applications with better productivity and efficiency. The application is divided into two parts, Frontend and Backend. The Frontend purely consists of the GUI development of android application. The backend provides connectivity to cloud storage provided by Firebase. The Frontend and Backend together produce a single platform which then in turn is divided into four main modules. The modules provided are combined under a single platform to provide better data integrity, reusability, connectivity and modularity between various modules. The domain explored is in the educational sector. It provided a perfect platform to test the product in a growing industry.

articleTitle: “Predictive Analytics for Stock Markets Using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs)”
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Financial data is highly complex, with many interdependencies, exhibiting complex temporal correlations and relationship patterns. Therefore, the prediction for stock market movements can indeed be quite complex. In traditional models, stocks are treated in isolation while ignoring the network of relationships of companies and industries. This work introduces the concept of the Non-IID Spatial-Temporal Graph Neural Network (NIST-GNN) model capturing the spatial relationships of the companies as well as patterns in sequences of the stock. The model is built using a tool in the form of Semantic Company Relationship Graph, SCRG, based on cosine similarities from financial news embeddings. The Sharpe Ratio that is gained by the NIST -GNN over the benchmark models is 0.40, and thus its predictive performance and portfolio optimization gain is superior. Furthermore, it is also understandable how information diffuses mainly in between cross-correlated firms of one day lag within the market. These insights challenge traditional market efficiency views and offer new avenues for financial prediction research.

articleTitle: Improving Short-Term Weather Predictions Using GANs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Short term weather forecast is very important to different fields like agriculture, disaster management and urban planning. Inherent complexity and non-linearity of atmospheric data presents a challenge for traditional forecasting methods. In a paper written this week, we propose a new way to improve short-term weather predictions using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), which are effective at generating high dimensional data. To increase the prediction accuracy, we propose a GAN architecture tailored for time series weather data that utilizes historical weather patterns. In the model are trained on extensive datasets of temperature, humidity, and precipitation and able to approximate the nature of weather phenomena. We show that the GAN based scheme outperforms conventional forecasting techniques in RMSE and MAE metrics. Additionally, visual comparisons show that GAN generated forecasts are closer to observed weather conditions. This work demonstrates the potential for use of GANs in transforming weather forecasting methodologies, the foundation for future exploration of their use in meteorology.

articleTitle: EfficientCLIP-GAN: Enabling Real-time Text-to-Image Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Synthesis of text to images has become a powerful technology, but existing methods often suffer from high computational demands, slow generation times and limited control over the generated images. This paper introduces EfficientCLIP-GAN, a new model for deep learning that addresses these limitations. EfficientCLIP-GAN using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to their full potential and the pre-trained CLIP model to achieve superior efficiency, enhanced controllability and unprecedented speed. The proposed architecture integrates CLIP into the GAN framework, enabling efficient prompt understanding, image-text matching, and more discriminative power. EfficientCLIP-GAN demonstrate superior efficiency, require substantially less training data and processing power than other approaches. Furthermore, it facilitates precise control over the images that are produced based on textual description, ensuring precise adherence to user prompts. Notably EfficientCLIP-GAN generates high-resolution images ~100 times faster than existing approaches, allowing for real-time CPU-based inference. This exceptional speed and efficiency make the model accessible for deployment on the low-power devices, democratizing access to production of images from text. Experimental results on the CUB dataset validate the model's effectiveness in creating a variety of realistic bird representations from written specifications. EfficientCLIP-GAN exhibits rapid training and convergence due to CLIP integrated generator and discriminator, In contrast to diffusion and autoregressive models, our approach thus needs 3% training data and 5% learnable parameters.

articleTitle: From Text to Treatment: Large Language Models in Clinical Practice and Medical Research
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Large language models have proven to be highly versatile tools applicable to many different subject areas and industries, including medicine. LLMs such as ChatGPT can understand and create human-like text, answer open questions without specialization, and operate in a variety of areas. They have elicited both optimism and rising fear of usage in healthcare. Specifically, the flow examines how LLMs began in healthcare and the present applications to clinical care, education, and research. LLM advantages discussed include improving exclu-sively unique tasks, increasing communication with patients, and providing administrative data and backing for experimentation efforts. However, this study also considers critical weaknesses and challenges such as predisposition, Ambiguous reasoning, and potential misinformation, as well as different consequences of applying LLM to biomedical challenges. It is included as an overview for clinical and experimenting to provide an informed decision when deciding if LLMs should be integrated into medical care. The unbiased use of LLMs can enhance patient care and increase the understanding of its practice.

articleTitle: Fraud Transaction Detection Using Machine Learning on Financial Database
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Financial fraud poses a significant threat to the digital economy, with credit card fraud being a prevalent challenge. This study evaluates the performance of a Voting Classifier Ensemble, Logistic Regression (LR), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and AutoEncoder with Gradient Boosting models in detecting fraudulent transactions using financial datasets. The study uses practical data from 284,807 transactions, but only 492 are fraudulent; the imbalanced class issue is solved using the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE). Our findings show that Voting Classifier Ensemble is the best with 99.93% accuracy, 100% precision, 86% recall and 90% F1 Score. XGBoost yielded an accuracy of 99.96%, precision of 95.11%, recall of 79.61%, and F1 score of 86.61%, while for Logistic Regression, the corresponding percentage was 99.92%, 88.1%, 60.5%, and 71.7%. AutoEncoder with Gradient Boosting had an accuracy of 99.98%, precision 99.81%, recall 64%, F1 Score 69%. The AUC statistic of 0.98 for XGBoost and Voting Classifier Ensemble against 0.97 for LR, and 0.46 for AutoEncoder wjth Gradient Boosting classified the models as having better discriminant power. The results show that XGBoost is more suitable for real-time fraud detection. However, computational limitations and explainability issues should be considered. For future work, it is suggested that semi-supervised and supervised learning approaches be investigated and work with larger datasets to improve fraud detection in financial systems.

articleTitle: Detection of AI-Generated Text
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: This research paper investigates the challenges posed by the proliferation of AI-generated content in the context of plagiarism detection and classification. Leveraging advanced language models, particularly the GPT-2 model, in tandem with tailored metrics and confidence thresholds, our approach provides a comprehensive solution to tackle this pressing issue. By employing tokenization and perplexity calculation techniques, we evaluate the coherence and naturalness of text inputs, thereby identifying potential AI-generated content. Additionally, burstiness score computation aids in discerning repetitive language patterns, further contributing to the detection process. Furthermore, integrating a BERT-based text classification model enables the classification of text based on its conformity to AI-generated characteristics, with a set confidence threshold determining the likelihood of AI generation. Through experimental evaluation, our approach demonstrates high accuracy in detecting AI-generated content while minimizing false positives. Moreover, we explore the impact of adjusting the confidence threshold on the sensitivity and specificity of the classification mechanism. Overall, this research presents a robust framework for AI plagiarism detection and classification, offering a scalable and adaptable solution for effectively identifying AI-generated text.

articleTitle: Enhancing ELT with Synchronous and Asynchronous Scaffolding: Cognitive Insights from Monolingual and Bilingual Classrooms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: This paper targets the English Language Teaching among the schools and colleges with the concept of the attitudes of the students as their perceptions and practice further aids them to get command on the language skills. The instructional trainings as given to get the hold on language is generally given in a dual mode as it is difficult for the non- native speakers to get fluency in the other language. It is believed that bilingualism adds advantage to the user with the benefit to communicate effectively; further this expands their social circles and increasing their opportunities to have employment. The paper aims to focus on the Cognitive Approach of the students while practicing the mono and bilingual approaches in the classroom space. The research is based on the data collected from almost 100 students from the classes where bilingual skills are more implied, the native language is also used as medium of instruction as twisted dictation. In this study reliability of the variables is calculated through Cronbach's Alpha and descriptive analysis is used to analyse the normalcy of the data, further the association between the variables has been analysed by employing correlation and multiple linear Regression analysis SPSS version 26.0 statistical software. The study clearly shows the significant and positive association between Cognitive approach (Dependent variable), Mono and bilingual perspective and classroom environment (Independent variable).

articleTitle: CodeQuest-A Comprehensive Code Learning and Collaboration Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The rapid changing of technology environment has led to an effective, and accessible coding education for equipping individuals with the skills needed to survive in the digital industry. The traditional teaching methods often fall short in providing the personalized, engaging, and practical experiences necessary for deep understanding and mastery of coding and technical skills. The COVID-19 epidemic has unfolded the importance of online platforms that offer both individualized and real-time learning, towards remote education. To address these challenges, this paper introduces a comprehensive DSA learning platform that integrates real-time collaborative coding with code synchronization, interactive and personalized learning through AI-powered chatbots, and a flexible code editor for hands-on practice. The platform is designed to enhance user engagement and build practical coding skills, for better preparation of individuals targeting careers in technology.

articleTitle: Data Analytics in Wildlife Management Business Insights and Technological Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The integration of data analytics into wildlife management presents a transformative opportunity to enhance conservation efforts and operational efficiencies. As the global community faces unprecedented challenges in biodiversity loss and habitat degradation, innovative approaches are required to ensure the sustainability of wildlife populations. This study explores the application of advanced data analytics techniques to generate business insights and technological solutions that address the multifaceted challenges of wildlife management. By leveraging big data, machine learning, and predictive modeling, this research identifies patterns and trends that inform decision-making processes, optimize resource allocation, and improve monitoring and protection strategies. Machine learning algorithms are utilized to predict population dynamics, migratory patterns, and potential threats, while predictive modeling aids in forecasting future scenarios, enabling proactive management strategies. Data-driven insights optimize resource allocation, ensuring conservation efforts are both effective and efficient, prioritizing areas for intervention, and maximizing the impact of limited conservation funds. Advanced analytical tools enhance the monitoring of wildlife populations and habitats, providing real-time data that informs protection strategies and employs techniques like anomaly detection to identify and respond to illegal activities such as poaching. Case studies within the research highlight successful implementations of data analytics in various wildlife management scenarios, demonstrating significant improvements in habitat preservation, species population tracking, and anti-poaching initiatives. The study also examines the economic benefits derived from these technological advancements, including cost savings, increased funding opportunities, and improved stakeholder engagement. The findings underscore the critical role of data-driven approaches in fostering sustainable wildlife management practices and offer a comprehensive framework for integrating data analytics into conservation strategies.

articleTitle: A Predictive Framework for Financial Crashes Using Advanced Time Series Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The research explores how financial markets, specifically the NASDAQ and S&P 500 indices, react under pressure and seeks to predict market crashes using advanced time series techniques. Financial market crashes, such as those in 2008 and during the COVID-19 pandemic, have significantly impacted the global economy, making accurate crash prediction essential. The study employs ARIMA and GARCH models to forecast market volatility, integrating these models with dynamic GARCH extensions and wavelet-based time series decomposition to capture non-linear market behavior. Data from January 2021 to August 2024 was collected, with 921 observations for NASDAQ and 787 for S&P 500. The stationarity of the time series was confirmed through ADF and PP tests, supporting the use of ARIMA and GARCH models. The GARCH model detected volatility clustering, where periods of high volatility were followed by further increases, particularly in NASDAQ, with a GARCH effect of 0.912741. For S&P 500, the GARCH effect was lower at 0.6785330, indicating less volatility persistence. This study also employs a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) model to showcase thr capability of deep learning models to predict financial crashes. The RNN model with an MAPE of 5.18%, performs very well. These findings highlight the effectiveness of the predictive framework in forecasting market crashes, offering valuable insights for investors and policymakers.

articleTitle: A Unique Approach for Extraction of Images with 4 Amplification Factors Using SR -GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Deep neural networks are quicker than super-resolution methods regarding speed and accuracy. Yet, a big chal-lenge persists: addressing turning points when dealing with large objects. The optimization-based methods for super-resolution rely heavily on selection of the loss function. Unfortunately, results often end up noisy and unreliable because they struggle to maintain clarity in higher resolutions. This paper introduces a new adversarial algorithm known as SRGAN. It's designed to decode super-resolution (SR) images. Importantly, SRGAN is recognized as the first framework capable of extracting real images with up to 4x magnification. However, when paradoxical point loss is used for optimization, performance can suffer. The process works by enhancing resolution through mapping outputs to Real-world image space, which involves separate network. This network is optimized to distinguish between the super-resolution and original high-resolution images. Rather than relying solely on pixel spatial similarity, it uses redundancy informed by per-ceptual similarity. This advanced deep network can retrieve high-quality images from extensive public image collections. Through comprehensive Mean Opinion Score (MOS) analysis, it's evident that visibility shows significant improvements when applying SRGAN. The MOS scores achieved by SRGAN are nearly equal to the best results achieved by leading-cdge techniques.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Cloud Computing Resources via Virtual Machine Consolidation: Current Solutions and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: An explosion of various cloud computing services has occurred during the last decade on a global scale. Many people and companies now use cloud services to back up and transfer massive volumes of data. These kinds of records are kept in data centers located in the cloud, which use a lot of power to run. Carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions and increased electricity costs are two of the many negative outcomes of excessive power consumption. Consequently, there is a great deal of effort going into the scientific problem of designing and building cloud data centers that minimize energy consumption without sacrificing service performance. There is evidence that virtual machine consolidation strategies can help cloud data centers become more energy efficient. Finding the sweet spot between energy economy, minimizing Service Level Agreement Violations (SLAVs), and optimizing Quality of Service (QoS) is the biggest obstacle when it comes to virtual machine consolidation solutions. Academics have recently shown a strong interest in using AI techniques to consolidate virtual machines (VMs) to increase the efficiency of cloud resources. The purpose of this research is to examine the recently proposed strategies for making better use of cloud resources by merging virtual machines. Several criteria proposed throughout the last five years have been used to assess the ideas. An advanced method for doing research gap analysis is detailed in this work. The current methods for consolidating virtual machines, the challenges they pose, and the possible future advancements in this area are the focus of this research.

articleTitle: HandWave: A Convolutional Model for Indian Sign Language Recognition: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: For millions of people worldwide who are deaf or hard of hearing, sign language is their major means of communication. Despite the development of advanced recognition systems for American Sign Language (ASL), Indian Sign Language (ISL) has not received equivalent technological attention. ISL, being one of the most diverse sign languages with regionally varying gestures and complex hand movements, requires tailored technological solutions for effective recognition. This paper presents an in-depth exploration of using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for the automatic recognition of ISL. The proposed system leverages CNN's powerful feature extraction capabilities to recognize the subtle variations in hand shapes, positions, and movements that characterize ISL. Given that ISL includes a wide variety of gestures with significant spatial and temporal complexities, the CNN model is optimized to process both the spatial features of individual frames and the temporal dependencies between consecutive frames in gesture sequences. We curated a comprehensive dataset of ISL gestures, covering a wide spectrum of signs used across different regions of India. The model is trained on this dataset and evaluated for both static and dynamic gestures, achieving high recognition accuracy in real-time. This system is designed not only to facilitate communication but also to be scalable and adaptable for use in various real-world applications such as education, healthcare, and public services. Our research addresses the current technological gap in ISL recognition by providing a scalable, efficient, and highly accurate system. The implementation of such a system will play a crucial role in enhancing the accessibility of information and communication for India's deaf and hard-of-hearing communities, significantly improving their integration into the broader society.

articleTitle: Proactive Fault Prediction in Microservices Applications Using Trace Logs and Monitoring Metrics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: An increasing number of developers and researchers are embracing microservices due to the scalability and flexibility benefits they provide. Fault prediction in microservices architecture based systems is crucial for minimising computation costs and reducing development time. Early prediction of faults and their locations during the system development life cycle simplifies maintenance and enhances resource utilisation. To our knowledge, little to no effort has been made in predicting faults beforehand, instead most of the research that has been done thus far has been on detecting faults after they occur. Early error detection allows for proactive remediation, avoiding any negative impact on the performance of the application. This paper fills this gap by proposing a fault prediction model based on trace logs and monitoring metrics for microservices applications. The paper has inspected two different models for fault prediction of microservices application and the forecasting accuracy of these models is compared by using standard performance measures. A case study microservices application is used for empirical analysis of these models and the results indicate that RNN predicts the faults with minimum errors and higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Sustainable Economic Growth Through Data Analytics: The Impact of Business Analytics on U.S. Energy Markets and Green Initiatives
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Renewable energy consumption in the United States has substantially evolved over recent decades, largely driven by pressing environmental concerns, progressive policy shifts, and remarkable technological advancements. This research paper offers a comprehensive analysis of monthly renewable energy consumption data spanning from 1973 to 2024. The data is categorized by sector-residential, commercial, transportation, electric power, and industrial-and by energy source, including hydroelectric, geothermal, solar, wind, and others. By applying business analytics, this study examines critical trends and consumption patterns to assess renewable energy's influence on fostering sustainable economic growth in the U.S. and its implications for shaping future energy policy. The findings reveal a consistent upward trajectory in renewable energy adoption, with solar and wind energy demonstrating particularly robust growth patterns across the analyzed period. However, the adoption rates reveal notable variations between sectors. The electric power sector has emerged as the leading consumer of renewable energy, accounting for a significant share of total consumption. Conversely, the residential and industrial sectors exhibit much slower adoption of renewable sources, affected by distinct sector-specific problems, regulatory environments, and technological preparedness. Seasonal and monthly consumption patterns reveal peaks at certain times, indicating possible strategies to enhance renewable energy use. The study emphasizes the pivotal role of business analytics in facilitating data-driven decision-making in the energy sector, highlighting its ability to bolster green initiatives, encourage sustainable practices, and further the overarching objective of sustainable economic growth. These findings provide valuable insights for stakeholders, enabling a nuanced understanding of renewable energy dynamics.

articleTitle: “Advanced Anxiety Risk Stratification Using Regularized Deep Neural Networks”
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Anxiety disorders are widespread and significantly impact daily life, necessitating accurate and timely assessment for effective intervention. Traditional methods of anxiety evaluation are often subjective and time-consuming. This study introduces a deep neural network (DNN) model with L2 regularization designed to classify anxiety into four categories: low, moderate, high, and no. For stable learning, the model employs batch normalization, dropout for regularization, and hidden layers with rectified linear unit (Re functions. Trained on a diverse Kaggle dataset, which includes psychological and physiological features, the DNN achieves a remarkable classification accuracy of 92%. Anxiety evaluations may be automated using deep learning techniques, as demonstrated in this paper, providing mental health professionals with an effective tool for developing customized treatment programs. By adding more data sources, future research attempts to improve the model's predicted accuracy and scalability, thereby advancing automated anxiety assessment in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Exploring Term Weighting Methods for Kannada Document Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The documents classification is one of the vital natural language understanding tasks. The vector space model is used to represent the documents in terms space as vectors. The term weighting schemes are part of vector space model to represent the documents as vectors. In this paper, extensive empirical evaluations are conducted by applying various term weighting methods in combination of symbolic representation and selection method for two standard Kannada document datasets. Further, their results are compared with each other. In all experiments six different state-of-the-art classifiers are used for Kannada document classification. On the other hand, since documents analysis suffers from dimensionality problems the Regularized Locality Preserving Indexing (RLPI) technique is applied, and further experimental results are conducted with various term weighting methods. The symbolic classifier for Symbolic Representation and Selection Positional encoded-Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (SRS_PE-TF-IDF) representation yielded highest accuracy of 93.57% for large dataset with only 40 dimensions.

articleTitle: Machine Learning in Identifying and Alleviating Cyber Threats in Warfare
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Integrating machine learning (ML) into military cyber security has the potential to transform the way threats are detected and prevented completely. This study examines the efficacy of machine learning algorithms in cyber security, analyzes the obstacles encountered during their deployment, and presents empirical evidence gathered from diverse industry experts. The report intends to elucidate the present state and future developments necessary for proficient machine learning-based cyber security in combat by examining feedback from 200 specialists in the pertinent field of research.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Anomaly Detection System for Automatic Traffic Identification and Localization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Global data indicates that road crashes cause a significant portion of violent deaths. The human element significantly impacts the time it takes to dispatch the medical response to the scene and is correlated with the likelihood of survival. To improve public safety by finding and preventing deadly crashes, it is imperative to monitor traffic surveillance footage efficiently. Nevertheless, manual oversight of these movies is time-consuming, prone to mistakes, and ineffective. In response to this challenge, we present an anomaly detection problem-based deep learning system for automatically identifying and locating traffic incidents. To successfully collect and evaluate both time and space-based trends in video data, our technique uses a one-class classification framework that integrates spatial-temporal features and a mixture of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with the YOLO (You Only Look Once) model. Our approach can identify accident occurrences by concentrating on anomalous patterns that diverge from regular traffic behavior. Several real-world traffic surveillance datasets are used to assess the model, and the results show notable gains in qualitative and quantitative performance indicators. Compared to conventional methods, the results demonstrate how effective our methodology is at improving detection effectiveness and lowering the number of positive results. This approach marks a substantial leap in traffic surveillance by providing a scalable and reliable real-time accident identification and localization solution. It could enhance emergency response times and traffic management systems.

articleTitle: Detecting Paddy Leaf Diseases Using MobileNetV2 and Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The status of paddy plants plays a very important role in agricultural productivity because if the leaves are infected, then rice quantity and quality could plummet. This paper deals with examining disease recognition and classification in paddy leaves using the new methodologies of machine learning. The study works on a large-scale paddy leaf image dataset. We deployed MobileNetV2, an image-processing CNN model, on a large-scale paddy leaf image dataset to detect and classify common diseases such as bacterial blight, brown spots, and leaf blasts. The model achieved a validation accuracy of 96.97 % and a significant improvement in performance after fine-tuning, highlighting the impact of feature extraction techniques, data augmentation, and hyperparameter tuning on performance stability.

articleTitle: AI - Powered Financial Fraud Detection and Prevention Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: A financial fraud detection system which relies on AI technologies makes use of advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques to detect and avoid fraudulent activity in financial transactions. The system is designed to be very effective in the analysis of large data with a minimal potential of false positive ensuring that genuine transactions are not wrongly categorized as fraud. New data is integrated into the system automatically without any thrashing improving algorithms as time passes. Also adversarial learning techniques are included to subdue changes in fraud model, which would allow the system to be able to fore see and counter any potentially threatening adversaries learning the counter fraud strategies that evolve along with time. This system is capable of operating either independently or being incorporated within the existing finance system and there is no requirement of manual effort or real time training of employees to prevent or control fraud.

articleTitle: Exploiting EfficientNetB3, InceptionV3, and DenseNet121 for Enhanced Eye Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The various eye illnesses including glaucoma, retinopathy, and cataract are emerging as a major hurdle to health care provision especially because they are usually diagnosed late because of inadequate access to diagnostic instruments. This research proposes an early diagnosis and classification system of these eye diseases through a NN (CNN), trained on the retinal images. The proposed CNN improves three more well-architectured networks, i.e EfficientNetB3, InceptionV3, and DenseNet121 for feature extraction and diagnostic precision. The used models were trained to classify different eye diseases, and the final predictions were obtained in the form of weighted average to improve the generalization of the models. The performance of the system was measured by the confusion matrices, accuracy and F1 score, proving that the overall accuracy was high. Cross- validation was also perform to evaluate the model robustness The objective of this approach is to provide a dependable, fast, and self-serve system of eye disease diagnosis that should enhance the results for the patients and minimize the burden on the staff and doctors.

articleTitle: Optimizing MySQL Performance: Essential Techniques, Resources, and Best Practices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: MySQL is a popular open relational database management system developed using organizational programming to create and manage data. E-lag is widely used in many fields such as business, finance and healthcare. While data processing focuses on optimizing data for performance, organizational programming will optimize physical storage data. This research provides an overview of MySQL and its architecture, explores the various methods and tools used to manage and organize databases, and discusses the benefits of these techniques and how they impact MySQL performance. Reactive systems, such as AutoAdmin, focus on historical workloads, while proactive systems, like QB5000 and DQM, predict future workloads for fully automated optimization.

articleTitle: A Holistic Approach to Detecting Distracted and Drowsy Drivers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Distracted and drowsy driving is a significant cause of road accidents worldwide. This paper presents a novel system for detecting distracted and drowsy drivers using computer vision and machine learning techniques. This paper leverages multi-YOLOv8 models specifically trained to detect distinct distracted behaviors: mobile phone usage, yawning and seatbelt, achieving an accuracy of 95 %. By focusing on these critical indicators of driver inattention, our system achieves precise, real-time monitoring. The system also calculates the eye-aspect ratio and estimates head pose to assess further signs of drowsiness and inattention. An alertness meter, updated based on these factors, triggers an alarm when the alertness meter exceeds a certain threshold. The models were trained on a combination of a Kaggle dataset and a custom dataset, which includes instances of yawning, mobile phone usage, seatbelt usage, smoking, and drinking. This multi-model approach not only enhances detection accuracy but also addresses various distracted driving behaviors simultaneously, marking a significant advancement over traditional single-model and sensor-based systems.

articleTitle: Enhancing PD Diagnosis through Handwriting Analysis: A CNN-BiLSTM Model with Dual Feature Extraction and GOOSE Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Motor symptoms like stiffness, tremor, bradykinesia, and akinesia are typical of Parkinson's disease (PD). To aid in evaluation of PD, it is useful to analyze patients' fine motor control, especially their handwriting. There has been extensive research on the use of online handwriting acquisition techniques to detect PD by analyzing a variety of dynamic handwriting parameters. It is well-known that all current methods have their advantages and disadvantages, and that there has been much research into hand motion detection of single-modality data for the study of different contact besides noncontact sensors. This research presents a new deep learning model that integrates CNN, LSTM, and Bi-directional LSTM as a hybrid model for PD diagnosis through the use of handwriting images. With low resolution comes the intrinsic issue of balancing spatial and angular resolution. To solve this, this research offers a Feature Extraction (FE) approach. In both the initial and deep feature extraction phases, we present a novel method for picture reconstruction using a convolutional neural network (CNN) that integrates spatial and epipolar data. In order to efficiently assess both horizontal and vertical epipolar data, our network makes use of angle information during upsampling and uses dual feature extraction. The GOOSE algorithm then selects the most pertinent features, which increases the accuracy of the classification. Additionally, when compared to comparable research in PD detection, the experimental results show that the suggested approach obtains greater identification rates.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Driven Automation for Degree Certificate Authentication While Preserving Data Integrity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Academic records are constantly at risk of varying attacks which impede traditional methods because they implement manual processes and web services, something that SAC has already underlined as a threat. In this research, an endeavor has been made to investigate the way blockchain technology is benefiting certificate authentication and verification of degree certificates. This research paper develops a solution for using smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain to prove the security, transferability, and validity of advanced certificates. This helps to validate student academic records securely. The information about the same is kept in a hashed pattern on a blockchain for the verification process so that it is tamper-free. Application of this method delivers a safe, reliable and scalable answer for schools to authenticate & handle academic credentials.

articleTitle: A Cloud-Based Telemedicine Platform: Enhancing Healthcare Accessibility through Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The advancement of telemedicine, especially through the incorporation of cloud technologies, has dramatically changed the healthcare environment by improving accessibility, particularly for remote and underserved communities. This paper outlines the design, development, and execution of a cloud-based telemedicine system intended to mitigate healthcare inequalities. The web-hosted service uses cloud infrastructure that allows for online, real-time consultations, remote diagnostics and treatment from any place where there is an internet connection. Key features of this technology include video conferencing, ensuring data security, and convenient access to medical records for fast retrieval, although following regulatory standards such as HIPAA to ensure data privacy and security. Cloud technology provides scalability, flexibility, and cost-effectiveness, making telemedicine more feasible for patients and healthcare providers alike. Enhanced security measures, such as encryption and multi-factor authentication, protect sensitive patient data. The cloud-based structure enables the platform to handle increasing patient volumes without losing performance or user experience, thus improving the efficiency and accessibility of healthcare delivery. The portal does serve to exceed geographical barriers and minimize the need for direct visits and, thus encourages constant and preventive treatment. This paper discusses the revolutionary aspect of technology in the healthcare sector, and it lays down a framework for further developments of telemedicine.

articleTitle: Generative Adversarial Networks for Image Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have made significant strides in the synthesis of images, particularly in sketch-to-image conversion when we talk about Conditional GANs (cGANs) and CycleGANs. This study combines Conditional GANs (cGANs) and CycleGANs to improve sketch-to-real picture synthesis on the edge2shoes dataset. CycleGANs allow transformations using unpaired data, providing more flexibility, while cGANs use paired data for accurate input-output mappings. This work investigates a novel hybrid method to enhance quality, adaptability, and generalization in sketch-to-image tasks by combining the best features of both methodologies. The findings offer insights for future developments in visual domain adaptation and image translation.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based IDS for WSNs: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: A vital role is played by Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) in modern applications, ranging from environmental monitoring to healthcare and industrial automation. Nevertheless, WSNs are susceptible to various security threats, such as resource constraints, limited power supply, and vulnerability to attacks due to their inherent characteristics. A promising solution for enhancing WSN security by detecting anomalies and identifying malicious activities within the network are provided by the Machine Learning (ML)-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs). A comprehensive examination of recent advancements in ML-based IDSs for WSNs, highlighting various techniques, including supervised, unsupervised, and deep learning approaches is provided in this review. Each approach's strengths and limitations are discussed, evaluating their applicability in addressing the unique challenges of WSN security, such as real-time processing, energy efficiency, and scalability. The paper emphasizes the necessity of hybrid models, lightweight ML techniques, and secure, resilient WSN frameworks to address evolving security threats in WSN environments. The review concludes by identifying current challenges and potential future research directions.

articleTitle: Survey on Zero Trust Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The proposed Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) system merges Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing, and Cybersecurity on the Amazon Web Services (AWS) platform to offer a multi-layered, secure infrastructure. SHA-256 hashing, Amazon Cognito for safe user verification, and Amazon SageMaker for AI-driven insights to improve authentication procedures are all used by the system's authentication systems. While AWS Lambda allows automated actions depending on specific security triggers, AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) enforces user rights for access control. Additionally, the solution incorporates AI-powered threat detection through the use of CloudWatch for ongoing infrastructure activity monitoring, Macie for sensitive data and anomaly identification, and AWS GuardDuty for threat monitoring and detection. The system utilizes network segmentation using Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) and micro segmentation using network ACLs to isolate critical resources in order to secure data and communications. Network security is further improved by AWS Transit Gateway, which guarantees safe, controlled connectivity across VPCs. Strong encryption techniques are enabled by AWS Key Management Service (KMS) for data security and masking, and encrypted data management is offered by AWS Relational Database Service (RDS). These elements work together to produce a scalable, AI-driven Zero Trust Architecture that satisfies the expanding security requirements of cloud-based infrastructure.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Project Management Systems: Enhancing IT Project Efficiency Through MIS Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: This paper investigates the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) in IT project management systems, focusing on the potential for optimizing task allocation, enhancing project timeline predictions, and improving resource management. By integrating these technologies with Management Information Systems (MIS), this study aims to create a cohesive, data-driven framework that addresses common challenges in IT project management. The research leverages a dataset comprising project requests, titles, components, assignments, and completion timelines to develop predictive models and automated task allocation frameworks, assessing their impact on efficiency. The findings demonstrate that AI-driven methodologies markedly enhance project results by equilibrating workloads, accurately forecasting completion timelines, and optimizing resource allocation. The integration of AI with MIS offers a flexible framework that enhances efficient, real-time decision-making, aiding managers in managing intricate project demands and interdependencies. This study underscores AI's potential as a transformative tool in modern project management, demonstrating its ability to streamline tasks, deliver actionable insights, and enhance project efficiency.

articleTitle: SELO: Smack Echolocation Optimization A Novel Approach for Breast Cancer Thermogram Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: This research presents the advanced method of classification of breast cancer thermograms using a self-attenuated deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Meta-heuristic and evolutionary computation is popular in nature-inspired optimization methods. The classification model is trained using the novel Smack Echolocation Optimization (SELO) algorithm, which combines Dolphin Echolocation and Jellyfish searching features to improve the classification efficiency. The SELO algorithm shows better convergence speed and parameter tunability, which leads to improved classification accuracy. The SELO algorithms phases are based on the jellyfish search movements and dolphin echolocation behavior which ensure the discovery of the best solution. Comparative analysis of the existing methods shows the effectiveness of optimized SELO self-attenuated deep CNN. The precision, recall, and F1 measures for breast cancer detection are significantly enhanced. This study provides compelling evidence for the suitability of bio-mimicking optimization methods in medical imaging and shows the significance of early diagnosis of breast cancer.

articleTitle: Advanced Anomaly Detection for Network Intrusion Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: With the increasing number of cyber-attacks over networks, there is a demand for a more effective and efficient intrusion detection system (IDS) to secure systems. In this paper, we have mentioned the very high levels implementation of such model with Gaussian Naïve Bayes, Logistic regression, Random Forest. Emphasis is put on improving the accuracy of classification and lowering false- alarm rates, but we assess these methods to gauge their power in identifying malfeasant network activities. The models are trained and tested at NSL-KDD which is a standard benchmark dataset for IDS. Each algorithm is shown have computational efficiency, and can handle the multidimensional network traffic data. Logistic regression is a simple model because it is interpretable Though performance might get hampered due to its assumed feature independence. This is simply because of the fact that it ideal for quick and easy handling when classifying huge datasets which are Gaussian Naïve Bayes. With the help of several decision trees, Random Forest which is an ensemble-based technique has high accuracy and tolerance to noisy input. Results based on the testing have shown that Random Forest outperforms both Gaussian Naïve Bayes and Logistic Regression for detection accuracy and precision, in addition to providing similar computational accuracy. A comparative study is helpful in understanding these trade-offs and, based on it we can easily decide which algorithm to use for developing a real-time intrusion detection system.

articleTitle: Enhancing E-Voting Security with Multi-Factor Authentication Using Fingerprint and Cryptography Protocols in India
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The integrity and security of e-voting systems are the core to ensure free and fair elections in any country. As the process involves an enormous, highly diversified population in India, e-voting systems are open to a hugely diversified variety of imminent threats, therefore, extraordinary security measures are incumbent on safeguarding them. This paper deals with the implementation of multi-factor authentication in a manner intended to improve the security of e-voting systems by integrating fingerprint biometrics with visual cryptography and also the state-of-the-art cryptographic protocols. It is proposed that some of these vulnerabilities associated with conventional methods of authentication should be tackled by the use of biometric verification, which can provide each voter with a unique and immutable identity. A detailed survey is presented on the current challenges to e-voting security in India and the battle-hardened limitations of existing systems, providing a compelling case for robust MFA solutions. The proposed system uses fingerprint authentication as its primary factor and further fortifies this with cryptographic methods that ensure confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity of the entire process of voting, right from the voter's end to the final tallying of votes. Finally, it provides end-to-end security from voter authentication to vote-tallying using symmetric and asymmetric encryption, as well as secure hash functions. The approach is tested against common security threats with simulations and practical implementation on voter impersonation, data tampering, and unauthorized access. Our results show that a high degree of enhancement in the security and reliability of e-voting schemes can be achieved by integrating fingerprint-based MFA with cryptographic protocols. This work is, therefore, a part of the modernization and security effort within the electoral process in India and is hopefully going to be one prospective solution for protecting the democratic rights of its citizens.

articleTitle: Enhancing Smart City Infrastructure Through IoT-Enabled Predictive Maintenance and Real-Time Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The rapid growth of urban populations has increased the demand for smarter, more efficient city infrastructure. This paper explores the integration of Internet of Things (IoT) technologies into smart city infrastructure, focusing on predictive maintenance and real-time data analytics. By embedding IoT sensors in critical infrastructure components such as transportation systems, energy grids, and water networks, cities can continuously monitor and collect data. Using predictive analytics, this data can forecast potential failures, reducing downtime and maintenance costs while ensuring continuous service. Additionally, real-time data analytics allow for better decision-making and dynamic response to emerging situations, improving resource allocation and overall city management. This paper also discusses the challenges, such as data security, scalability, and system interoperability, along with proposed solutions to ensure seamless IoT integration. The findings demonstrate the potential of IoT to enhance urban living through increased efficiency and sustainability.

articleTitle: Quantum Cloud Computing in Multi-Cloud Environments for Safe Data Transfer Using Two-Tier Homomorphic Encryption
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Nowadays, data transfer has been vast online and on social media. Hence data security in the various cloud environments has been enabled to send and receive data. While transferring the data, some issues in the cloud environment are the lack of connectivity, control, and the insecurity of the password and the data. To handle this problem, data security and the internet connection have to be enabled for the cloud environments. The method of homomorphic encryption and the transport layer security protocol have been enabled for the analysis. The homomorphic encryption method converts the data to the ciphertext for making the text in the original format. Then the transport layer security protocol is used to authenticate the data, and the data integrity of the communication can be executed. The proposed system performs better than current protocols like Dynamic Level Based Integrity Checking Protocol, TLS protocol, and Lightweight Cryptosystem, making it a potential option for jobs involving safe and effective cloud information processing. Overall, the proposed Two-tier Homomorphic Encryption system exhibits improved execution time, security strength, resource utilization, communication overhead, and user satisfaction. It addresses issues such as connectivity gaps, control deficiencies, and password and data insecurity, making it an effective method for boosting cloud security in quantum cloud computing environments.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey on Code Summarization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: A thorough understanding of the program code is required for software development and maintenance projects. Although well-written comments are crucial for supporting this understanding, modern software frequently lacks them or has out-of-date versions. Automatic code summarization has surfaced as a viable solution to this problem. Even though this field has advanced significantly in the past ten years, there is still a noticeable lack of a current survey that compiles the most recent developments. This study classifies the articles based on using Abstract Syntax Trees (AST) in code summarization. It conducts a comprehensive evaluation of several code summarization research articles that employ AST and those that do not. The paper explores each of them based on state-of-the-art techniques. Finally, a brief overview of evaluation metrics for code summarization is provided.

articleTitle: AI - Driven Predictive Analytics for Dengue Outbreak Prevention: An Enhanced EWSORA-MLP Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Dengue fever poses a significant and increasing global health threat, and factors such as climate change, rapid urbanization, inadequate public health infrastructure and epidemic outbreaks often burden health systems in areas of rainy and sunny and tropical areas. This review focuses on the application of advanced predictive analytics in health care, specifically AI-driven approaches to dengue outbreak detection and prevention. We explore and compare machine learning models including self-order mapping, decision trees, and support vector machines, while Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Correlation etc. We build performance using the best based patterns Feature focus selection (CFS). Combining soil variables, meteorological data, and real-time medical data, our approach provides a comprehensive and robust framework for dengue prediction These frameworks, if targeted, are helpful health authorities intervene, for better resource allocation and evidence-based policy delivery.

articleTitle: Deep Learning — Based Feature Fusion and Estimation for Ensuring Software Resuability
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The document addresses the challenges and objectives in the field of software reusability estimation, highlighting limitations of existing techniques and proposing a novel approach using a Deep Neuro-Fuzzy Network (DNFN) optimized by a Competitive Tunicate Swarm Optimization (CTSO) algorithm. Key challenges identified include insufficient static coupling measures for object-oriented metrics, difficulties in predicting software aging and cost for mobile applications, and the dynamic nature of decision-making processes affecting reusability. Additionally, current methods like integrated random forest and gradient boosting techniques lack meta-heuristic approaches and deep learning integration for better accuracy. The proposed methodology involves extracting significant reusability metrics, transforming data using the box-cox model, and performing feature fusion with Levenshtein distance and Deep Residual Network. The CTSO algorithm, integrating Competitive Multi-Verse Optimizer and Tunicate Swarm Algorithm, is employed to train the DNFN. Through a comparative analysis, the proposed CTSO-based DNFN demonstrates superior performance in terms of MAE, MMRE, and SEM when compared to traditional neural networks and fuzzy inference systems, indicating more accurate and reliable software reusability estimation.

articleTitle: Optimizing Cross-Platform Development with CI/CD and Containerization: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: This review paper aims at discovering the integration of containerization within cross-platform development by using the help of Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment/Delivery (CI/CD) practices and tries to fill the existing gaps concerning the effects of containerization on the compatibility, performance, and security of cross-platform applications. We conducted a wide-ranging literature review and analyzed existing tools and frameworks like Docker, Kubernetes, and cross-platform development frameworks like Flutter and React Native. Our study has brought out best practice to enhance security and performance in containerized cross-platform applications. The findings suggest that containerization with MAC and AppArmor-based robust security may improve deployment and management of applications a great deal. The work contributes to this field by presenting actional insights and recommendations for developers as well as organizations adopting CI/CD pipelines for cross-platform development.

articleTitle: Time-Series Foresee Indian Stock Market Trends Based on Statistical Data Using Hybrid Method of Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: This study presents a powerful LSTM-based model designed to predict trends in the Indian stock market. By using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks-an advanced type of Recurrent Neural Network (RNN)-the model can effectively analyze time-series data while overcoming issues traditional models face, like ARIMA's difficulty with complex market patterns and the gradient vanishing issue in standard RNNs. By capturing long-term dependencies within a vast historical dataset of over 130,000 records, including stock prices and quotes, this model delivers accurate forecasts tailored to the Indian market. Evaluated with hybrid performance metrics such as Mean Absolute Error(MAE), Root Mean Square Error(RMSE), and confusion matrices, the results highlight the model's reliability and practical value for investors and policymakers alike. This LSTM model provides timely financial insights, enhancing strategic decision-making and risk management. It demonstrates how Hybrid method of Deep learning can uncover unique regional trends in emerging markets, offering a significant step forward from traditional forecasting methods and highlighting the strategic benefits of advanced AI in finance.

Author Keywords: long and short-term memory neural network

articleTitle: An AI-Powered Mental Health Assistant for Personalized and Adaptive Care
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The global mental health crisis highlights the urgent need for accessible, personalized mental health care. However, access to qualified therapists is often limited, especially in underserved regions. This paper introduces an AI-powered mental health assistant designed to address these challenges by providing adaptive, group-specific, and ethical support. Key innovations include a fine-tuned BERT model for detecting nuanced emotions and cognitive distortions, Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) to model emotional state transitions, and reinforcement learning (RL) to dynamically optimize therapeutic interventions. Emphasis is placed on ensuring ethical standards, including fairness and transparency, to create an inclusive and accessible tool. Evaluations suggest significant potential to provide transformative mental health care, especially for traditionally underserved populations.

articleTitle: Role of Big Data Analytics in Corporate Social Responsibility: A Technical Way to Attain Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Businesses around the world create economic and infrastructural development and at the same time have to be responsible towards the society. This social responsibility is fulfilled under the scope of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), the working of which in this technical era is supplemented by various technologies. Among those technologies, one is Big Data Analytics (BDA). The data which is big in volume, velocity and variety is termed a big data and the technique to analyze such data is known as BDA. This issue is less studies by authors and there are various gaps present in the studies already undertaken. To fill the gap in knowledge, the author in this paper has examined the studies undertaken previously by various authors in this context. The implementation of BDA by the companies in CSR scheme and sustainability has impacted the CSR regime and also the firm's performance in various aspectssuch as predicting and managing issues beforehand, enhancing social and environmental performance, identifying sentiments of stakeholders, ensuring energy efficiency, waste management etc. This study is limited to the BDA technology, while leaving out other technologies such as Machine Learning, AI, IoT etc. moreover CSR is examined in general without going into particular aspect of CSR. Further study can be conducted on various aspect of CSR along with various technology interventions.

articleTitle: Life Signs Monitoring System Leveraging IoT and ESP-Now
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: The rise of chronic diseases necessitates continuous patient monitoring, which traditional healthcare methods struggle to provide due to their reliance on sporadic check-ups by healthcare professionals. This research builds on existing frameworks by focusing on a more accessible and economically viable IoT health monitoring system tailored for small clinics, enhancing patient care through real-time monitoring. The system uses ESP32 microcontroller to process sensor data and communicates it via the ESP-NOW protocol, allowing efficient, internet-less data transmission to a web server for real-time monitoring. This project lays the groundwork for future innovations in health technology, promoting scalable and customizable solutions tailored to the challenges faced by small healthcare facilities.

articleTitle: Smart Farming with IoT: A Bibliometric Analysis of Trends and Developments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Use of IoT in agriculture, known as smart farming has greatly changed how farming is carried out in the present society. Thus, the main goal of this research is to present the bibliography analysis of the field of smart farming with IoT, including academic trends, prominent papers, and emerging topics. In general, this research based on the analysis of a significant amount of data from the major databases available identifies the areas of interest, important contributions, and trends in the chosen topics. The nature and development of this interdisciplinary field is examined with the help of a variety of bibliometric tools and methods. This paper utilized metrics such as citation analysis, co-authorship networks, and keyword co-occurrence to reveal the relationship between different components of research. The analysis shows the trend indicating the increase of the publication and citation within the recent years, pointing to the ever-growing role of IoT in smart farming, crops monitoring, livestock tracking, and supply chain management. Furthermore, the study reveals the top authors, institutions, and countries that help progress smart farming technologies. It also addresses and speaks about the interprofessional collaborations and about the importance of the transdisciplinary research in this context. Technological advancements of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and blockchain in smart farming, which are expected to see the future research work in this filed, are also discussed. Apart from that, this bibliometric study also offers insights into the existing state of research related to smart farming with IoT besides acting as a reference map for the readers including but not limited to researchers, practitioners, and policymakers.

articleTitle: Internet of Things in Corporate Social Responsibility: A Tool to Attain Environmental and Social Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: CSR can be said as a scheme through which a corporate obeys its social obligations and also obeying these obligations leads to achieve SDGs formulated by United Nations. CSR is being practiced for decades but in era of Industry 4.0, the businesses have taken a step further and included technology such as IoT and AI in formulation, implementation and reporting of CSR scheme. The present study takes into consideration the integration of IoT technology in environmental and social CSR and studies its impact. The study found that integration of IoT technology in CSR scheme had two-way impact, on one side it promotes both environmental and social sustainability by detecting and mitigating pollution, by enabling effective waste discharge and by providing better and safe working conditions, mitigation of accidents, respectively but on the other side the integration of technology has also created employment and privacy issues. The study limits its scope till study of IoT technology into two aspects of CSR i.e., environmental and social. The further studies can be conducted on effect of integration of technologies such as AI and Big Data on the CSR schemes and other aspect of environmental and social sustainability can be studied.

articleTitle: XGBGenA in Dual-Band Antenna Design Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Progressive Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Data Science (ICPIDS)
abstract: Antenna design optimization for modern wireless systems presents significant challenges due to the complexity of navigating vast design parameter spaces. Traditional approaches involving manual tuning and exhaustive simulations often falter in tackling these computational demands efficiently. This paper introduces XGBGenA, a novel antenna design optimization methodology leveraging machine learning to circumvent time-consuming simulations. XGBGenA synergistically combines the predictive capabilities of the XGBoost algorithm with the global search proficiency of genetic algorithms. Generative algorithm is used to find the best hyperparameters for XGBoost which will be later used for prediction of the operating frequencies. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate XGBGenA's superiority over benchmarked techniques, achieving over 96% accuracy in predicting antenna metrics with Mean Square Error (MSE) of 0.1735 for first resonating frequency (Fr1) and 98.39% accuracy for second resonating frequency (Fr2) with an MSE value of 0.05356. The validated performance of XGBGenA on unseen antenna designs further demonstrates its potential for real-world applications in accelerating the development of optimized antennas for modern wireless systems.
